purpose: Teach: 胴/天地/断層/母語/鉱業/私生活/積雪/雌

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、人体の胴体構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you covered human torso anatomy in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle confirmation-check in the tone. Teacher-to-student but not lecturing. Steady eye contact, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、神話の天地創造を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about mythology and creation myths.
lines.style: Direct, clear answer. Slight lift of certainty on the opening affirmation. No embellishment. Respectful but not deferential. Meeting her gaze steadily.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地震断層の調査を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Earthquake fault surveys — you covered that in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Mild surprise underneath. Thoughtful pause before continuing. Interested, not correcting. Tone suggests she's genuinely trying to recall or reconcile the information.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、母語習得の発達心理学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about language acquisition and developmental psychology.
lines.style: Clear, composed response. Straightforward delivery without seeking approval. Steady tone, no apology. Meeting the apparent mismatch with calm directness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代日本の鉱業発展史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The history of mining development in modern Japan — that was in your paper?
lines.style: Engaged but probing gently. Light emphasis on the question itself, as if rechecking details. Warm tone but with a thread of observation running underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、芸能人の私生活と健康を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about celebrity private lives and health.
lines.style: Unwavering confidence in her response. Direct eye contact. No defensiveness, no hesitation. The tone says she knows exactly what she wrote and stands by it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 山岳の積雪量変動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Mountain snowfall patterns and variations — you covered that, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower pace. The tone carries gentle curiosity mixed with observation. Not challenging, but genuinely wondering. Soft delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ミツバチの雌の役割を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the role of female honeybees.
lines.style: Final answer. Calm and certain. Slight natural close, as if finishing a thought. No extra effort, just the honest fact. Breath settles at the end.
